summary: Composite risk rose 1.37 to 50.39, a high for the sample, with the weekly trend at 6.26 and the monthly trend at 8.33 while the level stayed in the caution band and the regime held at goldilocks. The two blocks that drove the advance are both risk-raising rather than tape-confirming: macro rose to 69.8 on a 2026-09-25 rates vintage that still leaves the ten-year at 5.17 in the 99.92nd percentile and the real rate at 2.83 in the 99.92nd percentile, and volatility jumped to 24.2 as the VIX observation advanced to the 2026-09-28 close at 16.07 from 14.87. The US session was a reversal rather than a broad risk-on move: 12 of 22 tracked sectors and themes advanced, led by semiconductor equipment at 2.8558 and networking at 1.7461, with autonomous driving at -1.6673 at the bottom, while AVGO at 1.6034 and MU at 1.5 offset NVDA at -0.3736 and TSLA at -1.4044. Internals kept deteriorating underneath: breadth above the 200-day at 0.5484, 1 new high against 17 new lows across 156 names, semis relative at -13.7176, and HY OAS widening to 3.02 from 2.93. The tracked A-share panel closed 10 of 11 names higher, led by 688825.sh at 3.2528 percent and 603986.sh at 2.5271 percent. The post-market read is therefore a higher score built on discount-rate and volatility repricing rather than on participation, with the 2026-09-30 PCE release as the immediate test.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The discount-rate constraint stays binding: the ten-year at 5.17 sits in the 99.92nd percentile with a risk score of 99.84, and the real rate at 2.83 sits in the 99.92nd percentile with a risk score of 99.92, behind a macro block at 69.8.
Volatility repriced higher: the VIX observation advanced to 16.07 from 14.87, lifting the volatility block to 24.2 from 14.93, against realized volatility of 11.0561.
Credit widened against the equity advance: HY OAS at 3.02 from 2.93 and IG OAS at 0.83 from 0.81, leaving the liquidity and credit block flat at 50.19.

Equity structure is the weakest block behind the score: breadth above the 200-day at 0.5484, 1 new high against 17 new lows among 156 names, semis relative at -13.7176 and small caps relative at -9.5714.
Cross-asset confirmation halved to 0.5, with only 5 of 10 tracked signals triggered, so the composite is rising on the macro and volatility blocks rather than on confirming market signals.

supporting_signals.claim: Fed communication stayed restrictive: Williams flagged AI investment as an increasingly important inflation factor and said another hike is possible this year if the economy meets expectations, Goolsbee noted the US has run above target for 5.5 years, and Musalem called policy still slightly accommodative; the effective funds rate is 3.88 against an implied policy rate of 4.16.
The AI-hardware complex led the tape: semiconductor equipment at 2.8558, networking at 1.7461, semiconductors at 1.3009 and data centers at 1.137, with AVGO at 1.6034 and MU at 1.5.

The tracked A-share panel closed 10 of 11 names higher, led by 688825.sh at 3.2528 percent, 603986.sh at 2.5271 percent, 002156.sz at 2.4788 percent and 688008.sh at 1.9175 percent, so the mainland semiconductor and memory complex did not confirm any global derating of the theme.

Memory-cycle news flow stayed constructive: Micron earnings this week are framed as the test of whether the memory boom has further to run, GigaDevice is adding ChangXin DRAM foundry volume, and the memory theme itself closed at 0.203.
Crypto held its bid with Bitcoin at 83559, Ethereum at 2695.53 and Solana at 119.29, a mild positive for the cross-asset risk appetite signal.

contradicting_signals.claim: The regime label still reads goldilocks on low vol, positive momentum and healthy breadth, but the volatility observation just rose to 16.07 from 14.87 and breadth above the 200-day is at 0.5484, the weakest of the sample, so the classification lags the deterioration.
Cross-asset confirmation fell to 0.5 from 0.75 in the prior layer even as the composite set a sample high at 50.39, so the score and the confirming signals are moving in opposite directions.

Traders trimmed the probability of an October hike to roughly half from roughly 70 percent earlier, which cuts against the layer's own hike-priced stance at an effective funds rate of 3.88 against an implied policy rate of 4.16.

Both inputs behind the volatility repricing lag the session: the VIX value of 16.07 is the 2026-09-28 close, not the 2026-09-29 session, and the rates block is a 2026-09-25 vintage, so part of the higher score reflects observation timing rather than today's tape.

The advance did not reach the laggards: auto at -1.4045, autonomous driving at -1.6673 and the EV supply chain at -1.2771 all fell, so the session was a leadership rotation rather than a broad recovery.

what_changed_today: The composite rose 1.37 to 50.39, a high for the sample; the caution risk level and the goldilocks regime were both unchanged.
The volatility block jumped to 24.2 from 14.93 as the VIX observation advanced to the 2026-09-28 close at 16.07 from 14.87, the single largest block move of the session.

The rates block rolled to a 2026-09-25 observation showing marginal easing at both extremes: the ten-year at 5.17 from 5.18, the two-year at 4.81 from 4.87 and the real rate at 2.83 from 2.85, with the curve steeper at 0.36.
Credit widened to HY OAS 3.02 from 2.93 and IG OAS 0.83 from 0.81, with the liquidity and credit block easing marginally to 50.19 while its trend stayed falling.

The tape reversed from a broadly lower session to a hardware-led advance: 12 of 22 sectors and themes were positive against only 2 of 22 in the prior layer, with semiconductor equipment swinging from -0.1193 to 2.8558, networking from -1.935 to 1.7461, data centers from -2.5152 to 1.137 and memory from -1.2954 to 0.203.

Quarter-end liquidity rebalanced: the RRP facility refilled to 11.446 from 0.851 on a same-day vintage, alongside balance sheet at 6747704 from 6746548, reserve balances at 2930193 from 3013794 and the Treasury general account at 977084 from 877028 on a 2026-09-23 vintage.

No flight to quality appeared in the commodity complex: crude futures settled sharply lower as OPEC+ delegates signalled adherence to output quotas, gold fell 2.777 percent and copper rose 1.2717 percent.

AI corporate flow continued: AMD agreed to acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs, OpenAI unveiled its Dots agent tooling and is reported to be in talks for a new funding round, and Trump met tech leaders on AI self regulation.
watch_next: The 2026-09-30 Personal Income and Outlays release, flagged high importance and carrying the Fed's preferred inflation measure, is the immediate test of the hike pricing.
The 2026-09-30 GDP release at the same timestamp, then the 2026-10-02 Employment Situation, complete the week's macro gauntlet.
Micron's earnings this week are the key read on whether the memory cycle has further to run, and they land on the same complex that led today's tape.

Whether the VIX observation rolls forward past the 2026-09-28 close and whether the rates vintage advances beyond 2026-09-25: a genuine roll would confirm or defuse the volatility repricing now carrying the score.
Whether breadth repairs above the 200-day line from 0.5484 and whether semis relative recovers from -13.7176; both remain the clearest participation test.
The quarter-end turn after 2026-09-30: whether the RRP refill reverses and whether reserve balances stabilise, given the block is already dated 2026-09-23.

bull_case.title: Disinflation holds while the long-term trend stays intact
points: Core inflation is easing with headline CPI at 3.35302, core CPI at 2.44616, core PCE at 3.34414 and the 5-year and 10-year breakevens contained at 2.35 and 2.34, so the ten-year at 5.17 is a real-rate story rather than an inflation-expectations story.
The labor market remains firm with payrolls at 162, unemployment at 4.1 and initial claims at 197000, which supports earnings without forcing a sharper tightening.
The long-run trend is still constructive: price above the 200-day moving average at 6.2927, a drawdown of only -1.7188 from the 52-week high and 3-month momentum at 2.3756.
Risk appetite outside US large caps is intact, with Bitcoin at 83559 and the A-share semiconductor panel closing 10 of 11 names higher led by 688825.sh at 3.2528 percent.

base_case.title: Score high, tape narrow, PCE decides
points: The composite at 50.39 sits in the caution band with the regime still goldilocks, so the next directional move depends on the 2026-09-30 PCE print.
The repricing is rate- and volatility-driven: a ten-year at 5.17, a real rate at 2.83 and a VIX at 16.07 from 14.87 in a volatility block of 24.2.
Internals still argue for caution: HY OAS at 3.02, breadth above the 200-day at 0.5484, and 1 new high against 17 new lows among 156 names.
Leadership is concentrated and therefore fragile: semiconductor equipment at 2.8558 and networking at 1.7461 carried the tape while auto at -1.4045 lagged.

bear_case.title: Rates, credit and volatility tighten together
points: Both rates extremes are pinned in the 99.92nd percentile, the ten-year at 5.17 and the real rate at 2.83, so any further push higher compresses equity multiples directly.

Credit is leaking with HY OAS at 3.02 from 2.93 and IG OAS at 0.83 from 0.81, while the Fed balance sheet at 6747704 and reserve balances at 2930193 shrink against a Treasury general account at 977084.
Volatility has left its floor with the VIX at 16.07 from 14.87 inside a volatility block of 24.2 against realized volatility of 11.0561, an asymmetry that works against equities if it persists.
Breadth is already broken: 0.5484 above the 200-day, semis relative at -13.7176 and small caps relative at -9.5714, so a single high-volatility session could find no support.
